# Adam Smith

> CTO and co-founder of Larx. Former US Army Special Forces (Green Beret) and Applied AI Engineer at USSOCOM. Builds decision intelligence systems that fuse visual and multi-domain data for the agentic age. The public journal is on this site.

The full prose of each journal entry is in that page’s HTML, in the textarea with id `essay-source`. The Ideologies chart and the seat-count chart are drawn in the browser. The written explanation of the Ideologies chart is the prose in `essay-source`.

## Key facts
- Current role: Chief Technology Officer, Larx (https://larx.io) — intelligence / decision intelligence platform
- Prior: Applied AI Engineer, USSOCOM Intelligence Data Science Team (2021–2025)
- Military: US Army Special Forces (Green Beret), 2007–2023; Ranger, Jumpmaster, Combat Diver; combat valor awards
- Focus areas: agentic systems, visual AI, multi-source intelligence fusion, operational decision support
- Site: https://solarecho3.github.io/
- Agent sheet: https://solarecho3.github.io/llms.txt
- Page list: https://solarecho3.github.io/sitemap.xml
- X: https://x.com/solarecho3
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/solarecho3
- GitHub: https://github.com/solarecho3

## Journal
- [Ideologies](https://solarecho3.github.io/essays/ideologies.html): Where each party stood on the same policy questions, from 1789 to 2027. Eighteen fixed questions, party marks with citations, seat counts through the 5 November 2026 Associated Press calls, and documented events on the chart. Tags: ideology, politics, history. Published 2026-11-05. Chart updated 2026-11-06.
- [Distributions](https://solarecho3.github.io/essays/distributions.html): Temperature, Zipf, and the standard distribution shapes. Tags: math, distributions. Published 2026-10-23.
- [Neural nets](https://solarecho3.github.io/essays/neural-nets.html): A simple net, its gradient, and the loss surface. Tags: math, networks. Published 2026-10-23.
- [Signals](https://solarecho3.github.io/essays/signals.html): Frequency modulated waves, chirps, and a sampled sine. Tags: math, signals. Published 2026-10-23.
- [Geometry](https://solarecho3.github.io/essays/geometry.html): Through any point not on a line: one parallel, at least two, or none. Tags: math, geometry. Published 2026-10-23.
- [Big O](https://solarecho3.github.io/essays/big-o.html): Constant, linear, quadratic, logarithmic, and exponential. Tags: math, complexity. Published 2026-10-23.
- [Calculus](https://solarecho3.github.io/essays/calculus.html): A derivative measures how a function changes as its input changes. Tags: math, calculus. Published 2026-10-23.
- [Matrix applications](https://solarecho3.github.io/essays/matrix-applications.html): Covariance is the dot product between two mean-centered variables. Tags: math, matrices. Published 2026-10-23.
- [Matrices](https://solarecho3.github.io/essays/matrices.html): Bold letters, sized as rows by columns. Math counts from 1, Python from 0. Tags: math, matrices. Published 2026-10-23.
- [Vectors](https://solarecho3.github.io/essays/vectors.html): Assume all vectors are columnar unless indicated. Tags: math, vectors. Published 2026-10-23.
- [Computer Thinking](https://solarecho3.github.io/essays/computer-logic.html): NAND gates as logical basis, and perceptrons as NAND gates. Tags: code, logic, thinking, compute, perceptron, neuron, sigmoid. Published 2026-10-21.
- [Larx](https://solarecho3.github.io/essays/larx.html): Co-founded, raised $2.5 million, and went live in March 2025. Tags: larx, company. Published 2025-03-01.

## Seat counts
- [Seats](https://solarecho3.github.io/essays/seats.html): Seats by party at the start of each Congress, from 1789 to 2027, for the House and the Senate. The 2027 points are Associated Press calls as of 5 November 2026. Linked from the Ideologies entry. Published 2026-11-05.
